introHtml: Gem hot cold packs combine reliable temperature therapy with your branding. Choose from shapes like the Plush Heart or Doctor Hot/Cold Pack to match your industry. Decorate with your logo using full-color or one-color imprinting for a professional look that stands out in any workplace or giveaway.
